motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that the Council instruct the Department of Transportation to report on the status of the BlueLA EV carsharing program, including: • The status of the BlueLA / Blink Mobility contract and the company’s obligations to provide services to City residents; • The number of EV charging stations that were installed as part of the program, their current condition, and options for utilizing/repurposing/disposing of them; • The number of BlueLA users between 2018 and 2021 with a breakdown by location; • Current transit options in the neighborhoods where BlueLA was previously available; and • Potential opportunities for launching a new EV carsharing program. title: BlueLA EV Carsharing Program / Blink Mobility / Transit Options
